metas.name: Frankenstein
metas.description: Dr. Victor Frankenstein, a brilliant but egotistical scientist, brings a creature to life in a monstrous experiment that ultimately leads to the undoing of both the creator and his tragic creation.

metas.name: Superman
metas.description: Superman must reconcile his alien Kryptonian heritage with his human upbringing as reporter Clark Kent. As the embodiment of truth, justice and the American way he soon finds himself in a world that views these as old-fashioned.

metas.name: Send Help
metas.description: An overworked analyst and her arrogant nepo-baby boss survive a plane crash near Thailand and must cooperate to survive on a remote jungle island while their workplace power dynamic collapses around them.

metas.name: The Exorcist
metas.description: When a mysterious entity possesses a young girl, her mother seeks the help of two Catholic priests to save her life.

metas.name: Anora
metas.description: A young stripper from Brooklyn impulsively marries the son of Russian oligarchs, but her fairy tale is threatened when his parents set out for New York to get the marriage annulled.

metas.name: The Matrix
metas.description: A computer hacker discovers that his life is nothing more than an elaborate simulation run by an evil AI.

metas.name: Remarkably Bright Creatures
metas.description: Through unlikely bonds formed during night shifts at a local aquarium, Tova, an elderly widow, learns of a life-changing discovery that may bring her joy and wonder once again.

metas.name: Hellraiser
metas.description: A woman discovers the newly resurrected, partially formed, body of her brother-in-law and lover. She starts killing for him to revitalize his body and escape the demonic beings that are pursuing him after he escaped their underworld.

metas.name: 28 Years Later: The Bone Temple
metas.description: As Spike is inducted into Jimmy Crystal's gang on the mainland, Dr. Kelson makes a discovery that could alter the world.

metas.name: Norm: The Tale of Norm MacDonald
metas.description: Judd Apatow's documentary on Norm Macdonald uses archival footage, photos, and home videos to chronicle the SNL legend's career—from "Weekend Update" anchor to master of absurd, deadpan comedy whose influence endures.

metas.name: Prisoners
metas.description: A desperate father takes the law into his own hands after police fail to find two kidnapped girls.

metas.name: The Rip
metas.description: A group of Miami cops discovers a stash of millions in cash, leading to distrust as outsiders learn about the huge seizure, making them question who to rely on.

metas.name: The Dog Stars
metas.description: In a post-apocalyptic world, a virus wipes out humanity. Survivors face roaming scavengers called Reapers. Protagonist Hig, a pilot, survived the flu but lost his wife.

metas.name: Inglourious Basterds
metas.description: In Nazi-occupied France during World War II, a plan to assassinate Nazi leaders by a group of Jewish U.S. soldiers coincides with a theatre owner's vengeful plans for the same.

metas.name: Blade Runner 2049
metas.description: Young Blade Runner K's discovery of a long-buried secret leads him to track down former Blade Runner Rick Deckard, who's been missing for thirty years.

metas.name: Dune: Part Two
metas.description: Paul Atreides unites with the Fremen while on a warpath of revenge against the conspirators who destroyed his family. Facing a choice between the love of his life and the fate of the universe, he endeavors to prevent a terrible fu...

metas.name: Poltergeist
metas.description: A family's home becomes the center of paranormal activity that opens a doorway to the "other side." With help, they must cross over to get their daughter back.

metas.name: 12 Angry Men
metas.description: The jury in a New York City murder trial is frustrated by a single member whose skeptical caution forces them to more carefully consider the evidence before jumping to a hasty verdict.

metas.name: GoodFellas
metas.description: The story of Henry Hill and his life in the mafia, covering his relationship with his wife Karen and his mob partners Jimmy Conway and Tommy DeVito.

metas.name: Wuthering Heights
metas.description: A passionate and tumultuous love story set against the backdrop of the Yorkshire moors, exploring the intense and destructive relationship between Heathcliff and Catherine Earnshaw.

metas.name: The Batman
metas.description: When a sadistic serial killer begins murdering key political figures in Gotham, the Batman is forced to investigate the city's hidden corruption and question his family's involvement.

metas.name: Heretic
metas.description: Two young Mormon women are drawn into a game of cat-and-mouse in the house of a strange man.

metas.name: American Graffiti
metas.description: A group of teenagers in California's central valley spend one final night after their 1962 high school graduation cruising the strip with their buddies before they pursue their varying goals.

metas.name: The Chronicles of Narnia: The Lion, the Witch and the Wardrobe
metas.description: Four siblings wind up entering the magical land of Narnia. Once there, they discover a world inhabited by fantastical creatures and find themselves in a battle to defeat a witch.

metas.name: The Devil Wears Prada 2
metas.description: Andy Sachs reunites with Miranda Priestly as they navigate their careers amid the decline of traditional magazine publishing.

metas.name: Shutter Island
metas.description: Two US marshals are sent to a mental institution on an inhospitable island in order to investigate the disappearance of a patient.

metas.name: Schindler's List
metas.description: In German-occupied Poland during World War II, industrialist Oskar Schindler gradually becomes concerned for his Jewish workforce after witnessing their persecution by the Nazis.

metas.name: Voicemails for Isabelle
metas.description: Jill leaves voice messages to her deceased sister telling her about her chaotic life in San Francisco. Unwittingly, a mysterious Austin TX real estate agent begins to receive their confessions..

metas.name: Bugonia
metas.description: Two conspiracy-obsessed young men kidnap the high-powered CEO of a major company, convinced that she is an alien intent on destroying planet Earth.

metas.name: Thunderbolts*
metas.description: After finding themselves ensnared in a death trap, an unconventional team of antiheroes must go on a dangerous mission that will force them to confront the darkest corners of their pasts.

metas.name: Heat
metas.description: A group of high-end professional thieves start to feel the heat from the LAPD when they unknowingly leave a verbal clue at their latest heist.

metas.name: Beetlejuice Beetlejuice
metas.description: After a family tragedy, three generations of the Deetz family return home to Winter River. Still haunted by Beetlejuice, Lydia's life is turned upside down when her teenage daughter, Astrid, accidentally opens the portal to the Af...

metas.name: Hamnet
metas.description: In late 16th-century England, Agnes, a healer sensitive to the world around her, builds a home with William, a local tutor and aspiring playwright. As their lives fracture, they are tested by distance, silence, and grief.

metas.name: Sense and Sensibility
metas.description: In Georgian era England, wealthy Mr. Dashwood dies leaving his second wife and three daughters destitute. The ladies move to a modest cottage where the two older daughters vie for the attention of various suitors in search of true...

metas.name: Nocturnal Animals
metas.description: A wealthy art gallery owner is haunted by her ex-husband's novel, her memories of their relationship, and her regrets about her life.

metas.name: Normal
metas.description: Centers on a temporary small-town sheriff who uncovers dark mysteries after a local bank robbery.

metas.name: Whiplash
metas.description: A promising young drummer enrolls at a cut-throat music conservatory where his dreams of greatness are mentored by an instructor who will stop at nothing to realize a student's potential.

metas.name: Friday the 13th: Part 2
metas.description: Five years after the events of the first film, a summer camp next to the infamous Camp Crystal Lake is preparing to open, but the legend of Jason is weighing heavy on the proceedings.

metas.name: Spider-Man: No Way Home
metas.description: Peter Parker turns to Doctor Strange after his identity destroys the life he knows, but a magical mistake draws powerful outsiders into his world and forces him to confront what being Spider Man really means.

metas.name: The Life of Chuck
metas.description: A life-affirming, genre-bending story about three chapters in the life of an ordinary man named Charles Krantz.

metas.name: Over Your Dead Body
metas.description: A dysfunctional married couple retreats to a secluded cabin to repair their relationship, but each secretly plots to murder the other.

metas.name: No Country for Old Men
metas.description: Violence and mayhem ensue after a hunter stumbles upon the aftermath of a drug deal gone wrong and over two million dollars in cash near the Rio Grande.

metas.name: Get Out
metas.description: A young African-American visits his white girlfriend's parents for the weekend, where his simmering uneasiness about their reception of him eventually reaches a boiling point.

metas.name: Resident Evil
metas.description: A special military unit fights a powerful, out-of-control supercomputer and hundreds of scientists who have mutated into flesh-eating creatures after a laboratory accident.

metas.name: Crime 101
metas.description: A meticulous jewel thief risks his flawless record against an equally obsessive detective and a volatile rival, while an underestimated insurance broker turns accomplice after decades of professional disrespect.

metas.name: Beetlejuice
metas.description: The spirits of a deceased couple are harassed by an unbearable family that has moved into their home, and hire a malicious spirit to drive them out.

metas.name: Poor Things
metas.description: An account of the fantastical evolution of Bella Baxter, a young woman brought back to life by the brilliant and unorthodox scientist Dr. Godwin Baxter.

metas.name: Speak No Evil
metas.description: A family is invited to spend a whole weekend in a lonely home in the countryside, but as the weekend progresses, they realize that a dark side lies within the family who invited them.

metas.name: The Mummy
metas.description: At an archaeological dig in the ancient city of Hamunaptra, an American serving in the French Foreign Legion accidentally awakens a mummy who begins to wreak havoc as he searches for the reincarnation of his long-lost love.

metas.name: Pirates of the Caribbean: The Curse of the Black Pearl
metas.description: An intrepid blacksmith teams up with an eccentric pirate captain to save his love from an undead pirate crew.

metas.name: Mickey 17
metas.description: During a human expedition to colonize space, Mickey 17, a so-called "expendable" employee, is sent to explore an ice planet.

metas.name: War Machine
metas.description: Follow the final recruits of a grueling special ops boot camp who encounter a mysterious deadly force.

metas.name: Wake Up Dead Man
metas.description: Detective Benoit Blanc teams up with an earnest young priest to investigate a perfectly impossible crime at a small-town church with a dark history.

metas.name: Avengers: Age of Ultron
metas.description: When Tony Stark and Bruce Banner try to jump-start a dormant peacekeeping program called Ultron, things go horribly wrong and it's up to Earth's mightiest heroes to stop the villainous Ultron from enacting his terrible plan.

metas.name: Halloween
metas.description: Laurie Strode confronts her long-time foe, Michael Myers, the masked figure who has haunted her since she narrowly escaped his killing spree on Halloween night four decades ago.

metas.name: Lee Cronin's The Mummy
metas.description: Eight years after her sudden disappearance in Egypt, a severely traumatized teenager is returned to her shattered family in New Mexico, triggering a visceral nightmare as they realize she is hosting an ancient, demonic parasite.

metas.name: Gone Girl
metas.description: The husband of a missing woman becomes the main suspect in her disappearance.

metas.name: Longlegs
metas.description: In pursuit of a serial killer, an FBI agent uncovers a series of occult clues that she must solve to end his terrifying killing spree.

metas.name: The Long Walk
metas.description: A group of teenage boys compete in an annual contest known as "The Long Walk," in which they must maintain a certain walking speed or get shot.

metas.name: Ready or Not 2: Here I Come
metas.description: Grace MacCaullay battles old wounds with her estranged sister Faith MacCaullay while rival occult dynasties hunt them through a deadly contest that promises power, survival, and betrayal before dawn.

metas.name: F1: The Movie
metas.description: A Formula One driver comes out of retirement to mentor and team up with a younger driver.

metas.name: Dracula
metas.description: Centuries-old vampire Count Dracula comes to England to seduce his barrister Jonathan Harker's fiancée Mina Murray and wreak havoc in the foreign land.

metas.name: Zodiac
metas.description: Between 1968 and 1983, a San Francisco cartoonist becomes an amateur detective obsessed with tracking down the Zodiac Killer, an unidentified individual who terrorizes Northern California with a killing spree.

metas.name: City of God
metas.description: In the slums of Rio, two kids' paths diverge as one struggles to become a photographer and the other a kingpin.

metas.name: Memento
metas.description: A former insurance investigator who now suffers from anterograde amnesia uses notes and tattoos to hunt down his wife's murderer.

metas.name: Incendies
metas.description: Twins journey to the Middle East to discover their family history and fulfill their mother's last wishes.

metas.name: Corpse Bride
metas.description: When a shy groom practices his wedding vows in the inadvertent presence of a deceased young woman, she rises from the grave assuming he has married her.

metas.name: Evil Dead Rise
metas.description: A twisted tale of two estranged sisters whose reunion is cut short by the rise of flesh-possessing demons, thrusting them into a primal battle for survival as they face the most nightmarish version of family imaginable.

metas.name: Gladiator
metas.description: A former Roman General sets out to exact vengeance against the corrupt emperor who murdered his family and sent him into slavery.

metas.name: Scary Stories to Tell in the Dark
metas.description: Pennsylvania, 1968. After playing a joke on a school bully, Stella and her friends decide to sneak into a haunted house that once belonged to the powerful Bellows family, unleashing dark forces that they will be unable to control.

metas.name: Monster House
metas.description: Three teens discover that their neighbor's house is really a living, breathing, scary monster.

metas.name: Ready or Not
metas.description: A bride's wedding night takes a sinister turn when her eccentric new in-laws force her to take part in a terrifying game.

metas.name: Forrest Gump
metas.description: The history of the United States from the 1950s to the '70s unfolds from the perspective of an Alabama man with an IQ of 75, who yearns to be reunited with his childhood sweetheart.

metas.name: Talk to Me
metas.description: When a group of friends discover how to conjure spirits using an embalmed hand, they become hooked on the new thrill, until one of them goes too far and unleashes terrifying supernatural forces.

metas.name: The Wolf of Wall Street
metas.description: Based on the true story of Jordan Belfort, from his rise to a wealthy stock-broker living the high life to his fall involving crime, corruption and the federal government.

metas.name: Marty Supreme
metas.description: Marty Mauser, a young man with a dream no one respects, goes to hell and back in pursuit of greatness.

metas.name: Apex
metas.description: A mountain climber haunted by a fatal decision in Norway retreats to the Australian wilderness for isolation. Her journey turns into a desperate hunt when a deceptive local targets her as his next ritualistic prey in the bush.

metas.name: The Witch
metas.description: An isolated Puritan family in 1630s New England comes unraveled by the forces of witchcraft and possession.

metas.name: Nuremberg
metas.description: A WWII psychiatrist evaluates Nazi leaders before the Nuremberg trials, growing increasingly obsessed with understanding evil as he forms a disturbing bond with Hermann Göring.

metas.name: Oldboy
metas.description: After being kidnapped and imprisoned for fifteen years, Oh Dae-Su is released, only to find that he must track down his captor in five days.

metas.name: The Green Mile
metas.description: A death row guard learns that a gentle giant in his charge possesses a mysterious gift.

metas.name: Gail Daughtry and the Celebrity Sex Pass
metas.description: When her fiancé uses their "celebrity pass" agreement, Midwest bride Gail Daughtry travels to Hollywood seeking revenge by pursuing her own celebrity encounter.

metas.name: The Cabin in the Woods
metas.description: Five teens visit a remote cabin and explore its cellar, finding strange items. When Dana reads from a book there, she unleashes zombie killers. But the situation is more complex than it appears.

metas.name: The Running Man
metas.description: A man joins a game show in which contestants, allowed to flee anywhere in the world, are pursued by "hunters" hired to kill them.

metas.name: Insidious
metas.description: A family looks to prevent evil spirits from trapping their comatose child in a realm called The Further.

metas.name: The Lord of the Rings: The Return of the King
metas.description: Gandalf and Aragorn lead the World of Men against Sauron's army to draw his gaze from Frodo and Sam as they approach Mount Doom with the One Ring.

metas.name: Hotel Transylvania
metas.description: Dracula, who operates a high-end resort away from the human world, goes into overprotective mode when a boy discovers the resort and falls for the count's teenaged daughter.

metas.name: The Others
metas.description: In 1945, immediately following the end of Second World War, a woman who lives with her two photosensitive children on her darkened old family estate in the Channel Islands becomes convinced that the home is haunted.

metas.name: American Psycho
metas.description: A wealthy New York City investment banking executive, Patrick Bateman, hides his alternate psychopathic ego from his co-workers and friends as he delves deeper into his violent, hedonistic fantasies.

metas.name: Top Gun: Maverick
metas.description: The story involves Maverick confronting his past while training a group of younger Top Gun graduates, including the son of his deceased best friend, for a dangerous mission.

metas.name: Addams Family Values
metas.description: The Addams Family try to rescue their beloved Uncle Fester from his gold-digging new love, a black widow named Debbie.

metas.name: One Flew Over the Cuckoo's Nest
metas.description: A rebellious convict is sent to a psychiatric hospital for evaluation in 1963 Oregon, and encourages his docile companions to take more control of their lives and defy the tyrannical head nurse.

metas.name: The Equalizer
metas.description: A man who believes he has put his mysterious past behind him cannot stand idly by when he meets a young girl under the control of ultra-violent Russian gangsters.

metas.name: The Texas Chain Saw Massacre
metas.description: Five friends head out to rural Texas to visit the grave of a grandfather. On the way they stumble across what appears to be a deserted house, only to discover something sinister within. Something armed with a chainsaw.

metas.name: Crazy, Stupid, Love.
metas.description: A middle-aged husband's life changes dramatically when his wife asks him for a divorce. He seeks to rediscover his manhood with help from new acquaintance Jacob, who teaches him to pick up women at bars.

metas.name: Bring Her Back
metas.description: A brother and sister uncover a terrifying ritual at the secluded home of their new foster mother.

metas.name: Scary Movie
metas.description: A year after disposing of the body of a man they accidentally killed, a group of dumb teenagers are stalked by a bumbling serial killer.

metas.name: About Time
metas.description: At the age of 21, Tim discovers he can travel in time and change what happens and has happened in his own life. His decision to make his world a better place by getting a girlfriend turns out not to be as easy as you might think.

metas.name: A Quiet Place
metas.description: A family struggles for survival in a world invaded by blind alien creatures with ultra-sensitive hearing.

metas.name: Back to the Future
metas.description: Marty McFly, a 17-year-old high school student, is accidentally sent 30 years into the past in a time-traveling DeLorean invented by his close friend, the maverick scientist Doc Brown.
